title: The Craft of Controlled Surgery
mathematical_role: Represent recognition of a local S2 x I neck, cutting on spherical cross-sections, removal, cap attachment, and the event ledger as one coherent staged composition.
learning_objective: Remember surgery as a theorem-governed geometric transaction with explicit topology bookkeeping, not arbitrary planar cut-and-paste.
literal_semantics: The teaching sequence is recognize neck, cut/remove, attach cap models and continue.
The local neck type is explicitly labelled S2 x I.
Two cutting cross-sections are displayed before excision.
The event ledger records recognized model, cut locus, removed region, continued geometry, and topology bookkeeping.
nonliteral_semantics: The rendered dumbbell and caps are procedural 3D schematics, not literal metric three-manifolds.
Displayed radii and lengths are not surgery scales.
The cap geometry is a teaching model, not a numerically constructed surgery cap.
The figure does not certify canonical-neighbourhood hypotheses or topology preservation.

notes: Representation-repair realization follows independent rejection of the SVG-only candidate.

renderer.version_or_environment: requirements/visual-pedagogy-render.txt; deterministic Matplotlib/Numpy raster renderer v4
reproducibility_notes: No randomness or external service is used.
Web and print PNG derivatives are reproduced byte-for-byte in CI.

derivatives.role: current 3D procedural review candidate; not live documentary asset

accessibility.alt_text: A three-stage 3D neck sequence moves from recognizing an S2-by-I neck through cutting and excision to capped components, with a topology event ledger below.
accessibility.long_description: The first stage shows a rendered dumbbell neck with two marked spherical cutting cross-sections. The second removes the middle neck. The third displays capped components. A lower ledger records the local model, cut locus, removed region, continuation, and topology bookkeeping.

claim_boundary.strongest_visual_claim: Pedagogical reconstruction of the recognize-cut-remove-cap sequence and topology-bookkeeping obligation.
not_claimed: Validity of a specific surgery event
A Ricci-flow construction or proof of the Poincare theorem

supersession_reason: Representation-layer repair replaces the rejected SVG with a genuine 3D staged neck transaction and separate print derivative.
